name: coneko-term
description: Terminal building blocks (VT parser and screen model) in Rust, as WebAssembly with TypeScript types

scripts.build:ts: tsc -p tsconfig.json && mkdir -p dist/wasm && cp -f src/wasm/* dist/wasm/
scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:ts
scripts.test: npm run build:ts && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test "test/*.test.ts"
